.claude/skills/impl-review-loop/scripts/.intentional_diff: Functional legacy slug (_DEFAULT_REPO) and idempotency marker prefix 'loop-protocol:contract-snapshot' replaced by agent-platform equivalents; + gh-readback-stable transport (#66): _json_compact now spells a backslash before u00XX as \\u005c, escapes U+2028/2029, and rejects real control characters that the `gh api` response sanitizer rewrites (raw U+0001-0007/000E-001F/0080-009F); compact_vc_preflight_classifications normalizes first (verbose keys: real controls shown as literal \\xNN, non-verbose keys exact or rejected) and measures the cap on the final transport JSON; ensure_contract_snapshot validates a final-shaped body before the provisional POST (see live_acceptance.transport_findings). Also bounds every embedded JSON value to the parser's 16384 chars / depth 32 and the body to 60000 chars, and rejects lone surrogates, all before the provisional POST.

transport_findings.probe_route: plain probe comment on disposable issue 67, not a snapshot and not through the executor: one POST with production post_comment() and PATCHes with production patch_comment() (gh api --input -) / raw gh api for the charwise sweep; kept as evidence
transport_findings.cause: GitHub stores the body verbatim. The gh api CLI sanitizes the JSON it prints: raw U+0001-0007, U+000E-001F, U+0080-009F and the JSON escape text u00XX for XX in 01-08, 0c, 0e-1f, 80-9f (any run of preceding backslashes) come back as caret notation; tab, LF, VT, FF, CR, BS, DEL and the spelling u005c come back unchanged. The earlier _json_compact (DEL/C1 -> u00XX) therefore could not work: the escape text it emitted is itself rewritten.
transport_findings.pre_fix_reproduction: production patch_comment() with real ESC/BEL/C1, literal u001b/u0085, doubled/tripled backslash variants all failed binding_body_hash_mismatch; DEL, u005c spelling, plain backslashes, NBSP and U+2028 passed
transport_findings.fix: literal backslash before u00XX is spelled u005c; U+2028/2029 escaped; real control characters that gh would rewrite are shown as literal xNN in verbose log fields only and rejected (before any POST) in every other field; the classification size cap is measured on the final transport JSON
transport_findings.post_fix_focused_live: production patch_comment() on the probe comment: a final-shaped body carrying every lossless hostile string and a body with real control characters in verbose fields both read back with matching SHA-256 (binding verified)
transport_findings.limit: real control characters cannot be tested through a normal contract because VC source text cannot carry them; that path is covered by the focused live test and offline tests with a sanitizer model fitted to the measured behaviour
